messages:
Lucy Tran: Hey folks — monitor showed up but the bag with the VESA screws was empty and the USB-C dock's power button is jammed (presses but doesn't click). Also the included USB-C->Ethernet adapter only negotiates at 100Mbps on my laptop while our office network is 1Gbps. Created ticket IT-4602. Anyone know who to tag? :slightly_frowning_face:

Harper (IT): Hi Lucy, sorry about the mess. Tagging self. Can you confirm the monitor model from the box and the dock part number? For the adapter, is the port showing 100baseTX? Run `ifconfig` and paste the en0 or enp0s* output. I'll also check stock for VESA screw packs and a spare dock.

Lucy Tran: Box label: "Dell P2419H". Dock label: "RD-DK100-v2". `ifconfig` shows `en0: flags=8863<UP,BROADCAST,SMART,RUNNING,SIMPLEX,MULTICAST> mtu 1500\n\tstatus: active\n\ten0: flags=...\n\tinet 10.2.5.43 netmask 0xfffffe00\n\tmedia: autoselect (100baseTX <full-duplex>)`

OnboardingBot: Ticket IT-4602 created and assigned to Harper (IT). Replacement VESA screw kit and test dock reserved. Estimated dispatch: 1 business day.

Diego (People Ops): Welcome Lucy! If you want a temporary monitor mount I can drop my spare VESA arm at your desk later today so you can mount it. Also bringing a powered USB hub in case the dock is underpowered.

Harper (IT): The media says 100baseTX which means the adapter or negotiation is stuck at 100Mbps. Two quick checks: 1) try a different USB-C port on the dock (if present) or plug the adapter directly into the laptop; 2) if you have a USB-A to Ethernet adapter in the laptop kit, try that. Can you also run `sudo ethtool en0` (or `networksetup -getMedia en0` on macOS) and paste output? I'll pre-stage a gigabit-capable adapter and a swapped dock.

Lucy Tran: Plugging the adapter directly into the laptop USB-C port gives 1Gbps immediately (shows 1000baseT in `ifconfig`). So it's the dock negotiation. No USB-A adapter in the box. Thanks for offering the arm, Diego 389 I'll take the arm and the powered hub if it's easier.

Harper (IT): Great repro. I'll mark the dock as DOA and ship a tested replacement plus the VESA screw pack. Leaving IT-4602 open for confirmation after you mount it. In the meantime use the direct adapter. ETA for replacement: next business day (tracking to be posted). :truck:

Lucy Tran: Awesome, thanks team! Appreciate the quick responses. :heart:
